_comment: MeshGrammar substrate — rule-based procedural mesh generation. Each recipe defines a seed shape, grammar rules, and generation count. The MeshGrammarNode applies rules to reshape topology. Use #recipe:<name> or named variants.

mesh_grammar.name: MeshGrammar Substrate
mesh_grammar.description: Universal mesh grammar substrate. Start from a seed shape, apply rule-based operations (extrude, inset, split, branch, scatter) across generations. The only substrate where the algorithm reshapes topology itself.

mesh_grammar_seed.name: MeshGrammar — Seed Icosahedron
mesh_grammar_seed.description: Raw icosahedron seed — no rules applied. The starting point for all mesh grammar forms. 20 triangular faces, uniform topology.

mesh_grammar_extruded_spire.name: MeshGrammar — Extruded Spire
mesh_grammar_extruded_spire.description: Two-stage extrusion on upward faces — pushes faces outward and scales them down, creating a spire. Demonstrates extrude operation and tag-based chaining.

mesh_grammar_inset_pattern.name: MeshGrammar — Inset Pattern
mesh_grammar_inset_pattern.description: Inset operation on all faces — shrinks each face toward its center, creating a lattice of gaps. Pure topological subdivision.

mesh_grammar_subdivided.name: MeshGrammar — Subdivided Sphere
mesh_grammar_subdivided.description: Midpoint subdivision on all faces — each triangle splits into four. The icosahedron approaches a sphere. Demonstrates split operation.

mesh_grammar_nodule_sphere.name: MeshGrammar — Nodule Sphere
mesh_grammar_nodule_sphere.description: Random bulge on sphere faces — sparse bumps with ring depth and smoothing. Organic ceramic-like surface.

mesh_grammar_coral_fingers.name: MeshGrammar — Coral Fingers
mesh_grammar_coral_fingers.description: Tube branches growing from upward-facing random faces — curved, segmented fingers reaching outward. Demonstrates tube_branch operation.

mesh_grammar_crumpled.name: MeshGrammar — Crumpled Form
mesh_grammar_crumpled.description: Noise displacement on upward faces — Perlin noise pushes vertices along normals. Crumpled, weathered ceramic surface.

mesh_grammar_budding.name: MeshGrammar — Budding Sphere
mesh_grammar_budding.description: Extrude random faces then delete the tops — creates hollow buds and openings. Demonstrates extrude + delete composition.

mesh_grammar_branching_coral.name: MeshGrammar — Branching Coral
mesh_grammar_branching_coral.description: Multi-generation tube branching — first generation grows branches, second generation branches from branch tips. Recursive growth from tag chaining.

mesh_grammar_inset_towers.name: MeshGrammar — Inset Towers
mesh_grammar_inset_towers.description: Inset upward faces then extrude the inset — creates architectural towers rising from a cube. Order of operations matters.

mesh_grammar_detailed_bulge.name: MeshGrammar — Detailed Bulge
mesh_grammar_detailed_bulge.description: Split all faces first to increase resolution, then apply sparse random bulges — fine-grained organic detail from subdivision + deformation.

mesh_grammar_noise_sculpture.name: MeshGrammar — Noise Sculpture
mesh_grammar_noise_sculpture.description: Cellular noise displacement on all faces — radial deformation creates alien, geode-like surfaces. Different noise type than Crumpled Form.

mesh_grammar_petal_flower.name: MeshGrammar — Petal Flower
mesh_grammar_petal_flower.description: Petal splay on upward faces — radiating curved petals with tilt and curl. Organic decoration operation.

mesh_grammar_scale_armor.name: MeshGrammar — Scale Armor
mesh_grammar_scale_armor.description: Subdivide then apply overlapping pointed scale tiles — armadillo-like surface. Split increases resolution, scale_tile adds decorative geometry.

mesh_grammar_riveted.name: MeshGrammar — Riveted Sphere
mesh_grammar_riveted.description: Extrude random faces, delete tops to create openings, then place edge beads along boundaries — industrial aesthetic from three composed operations.

mesh_grammar_barnacle.name: MeshGrammar — Barnacle Sphere
mesh_grammar_barnacle.description: Surface scatter operation — randomly placed small spheres across the mesh surface. Density and size range control the colony appearance.

mesh_grammar_lsystem_tree.name: MeshGrammar — L-System Tree
mesh_grammar_lsystem_tree.description: L-system branching from upward faces — fractal tree growth using turtle interpretation. Bush preset with configurable angle and generations.

mesh_grammar_ca_growth.name: MeshGrammar — CA Growth
mesh_grammar_ca_growth.description: Cellular automata on mesh faces — coral rule tags faces alive/dead, then alive faces extrude. Algorithm reshapes topology based on neighbor counting.

mesh_grammar_spike_ball.name: MeshGrammar — Spike Ball
mesh_grammar_spike_ball.description: Dense normal-aligned spike scatter — aggressive radial geometry from surface scatter with spike shape and high density.

mesh_grammar_blooming_bulge.name: MeshGrammar — Blooming Bulge
mesh_grammar_blooming_bulge.description: Sparse random bulges followed by petal splay on bulge tips — organic compound form where deformation creates the anchor points for decoration.
